title: Mixed Event — It's On! Wonder Halloween! — Episode2 Show Contest!

meta.Event Outline: Tsukasa and the rest of WxS begin preparing a Halloween performance for Phoenix Wonderland's Show Contest. However, Rui starts acting unusual after an incident...

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A Show Contest?
This is my first time hearing anything about that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So it's really happening...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought this would be your kind of thing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, umm...! It's just that there was talk about holding a contest at one point!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it never got anywhere because Grandpa said, There's no need to compete to be the best. Everyone is different and that's the way it should be.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So this news is a bit of a surprise for me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, this is a sudden change in policy...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A contest. I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right up my alley!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whaaa?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Lower your voice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This contest will reveal which shows by which groups are the most magnificent!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is my chance to shine as a star performer, then my talent as a leader will become known far and wide!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe... And maybe, just maybe... This theme park will earn recognition worldwide thanks to this!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, okay, we got it.
Just keep it down, will you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't act as if this doesn't concern you too, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This could be a big step towards fulfilling your dream of becoming a musical actress!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well... I guess it might help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aaand, more popularity means we'll have a bigger budget for awesome stage gear, which will make our shows just that much better!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm. I usually just construct what we need out stuff that's lying around... But I won't say no to having more funds.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uh, yeah... The more shows we do, the more people we can make happy...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: An event like this is a rare occasion, so we should join in and enjoy it♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If Emu's up for it, I have no objections.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great! What do we need to do to participate?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It says here, Phoenix Wonderland is delighted to announce that it will be hosting an exciting competition to determine which of its performing groups is the best.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Each group is to stage three shows during the event period. The audience will vote for their favorite each time as these groups compete to receive the most votes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I see. If it were only one show, the audience might pick based on a show's theme, so they want to vote in three separate parts.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: By the way, how many stages does this park have?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
10 if you include the small ones♪
And there's a group for every stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's that many?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How did you land a job here with zero knowledge...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, there's more?
In addition...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The winners will be featured in a TV commercial promoting Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wha...?! We could be in a commercial?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So I was right. Winning this contest is going to pave the road to stardom!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure about the whole stardom part...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But taking part in this challenge and performing in front of a bigger audience than we've ever had could be a good learning experience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I agree!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, it sounds like everyone's on board. Let's start working on a new show for this contest!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
The next day

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here we are! Our first order of business is to decide what our show for the competition will be about!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since we really need to win our audience over, it should be something showy, memorable and fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Let's make it about THAT!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Brilliant suggestion. I believe that will do beautifully.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: THAT! You know? When you go around with everyone at night, get scared and stuff, and it's super fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have no idea! Just say it already!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Err... It's called...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Halloween! It's Halloween!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Halloween?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... I see.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A Halloween show can be over the top in a good way. It has the potential to become a hit with the audience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! And we can have lots of spooky stuff too! Like jack-o-lanterns, zombies, giant spiders and...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: L-Let's leave spiders out of it...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I like the idea.
It's different and sounds fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
J-J-Just without any spiders, okay?
I still like the Halloween theme so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's do a Halloween show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Awesome!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then how does an adaptation of Potato Ghosts sound?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Potato Ghosts?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's not that well-known, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On the night of Halloween, spirits of the dead invade an amusement park after seeing the living enjoying themselves. It seems a night of terror is about to begin...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the park director welcomes the ghosts and invites them to join the Halloween festivities. The living and the dead end up celebrating together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: One after another, the ghosts rise from the ground like potatoes from a harvest and serve as the namesake theme of this play.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What a cool story! I love it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A play based on that story is sure to be a riot! It fits this park and the spirit of Halloween perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I like it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Let's divide the roles and start preparing. We're going to snag victory with this one. I feel it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hopefully. However, I will need your help with something if you don't mind, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sure, what is it?
